battle.name: 臨洺之戰
battle.brief: 建中二年（781）五月前後，吐蕃乘唐廷削藩、關中空虛再犯隴右，兵鋒直抵洮水南岸的臨洺城。唐軍據城固守，涇原與隴右諸鎮出兵拒之，吐蕃退回洮水上游。卡面的羅馬弩砲早此役八百餘年，城下並無此物；它一發一具、靠扭力蓄能的投射邏輯，正對應唐代的拋石機與機括弩。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 建中二年（781）五月前後，隴右洮水一線再度短兵相接。交戰一方是唐王朝的邊軍體系：德宗朝廷以節度使分鎮邊地，隴右節度使治秦州，涇原節度使治涇州，河中節度使治河中，劍南西川節度使治成都；各鎮募兵自給，兵權、財權與民政合於節度使一身，調兵須由中書省下詔、各鎮領兵發遣，跨鎮調動動輒要數十日。另一方是吐蕃王國在隴右的方面軍：自763年起，吐蕃逐步取走河西走廊與隴右的涼、甘、洮、岷、疊諸州，在洮水上游與河西一線屯駐據點，由贊普調派將領率騎兵與步兵東進；軍中除吐蕃本部兵外，還有大批被徵、被俘的河湟漢人與吐谷渾人，以及相傳編入軍伍的僧人。兩軍都不是國家全軍的正面交鋒，而是兩套邊疆體系在同一條河流、同一批渡口上長期拉鋸：唐軍以城固守，吐蕃以騎兵機動，爭的是臨洺、秦州與渭州這條通往關中的門戶。
countriesEn: The clash of 781 CE on the Tao River line in Longyou was fought between two frontier systems rather than between the full armies of two states. On one side stood the Tang military administration: under Emperor Dezong the empire governed the borderlands through regional commands, with the Longyou jiedushi seated at Qinzhou, the Jingyuan jiedushi at Jingzhou, the Hezhong jiedushi at Hezhong and the Xichuan jiedushi at Chengdu. These commands recruited and paid their own troops, fused command, finance and civil administration in the person of the regional governor, and could be moved only by edict from the Zhongshu Sheng, so that even a reinforcement of a few thousand men took weeks to arrive. On the other side was the Tibetan war effort in Longyou: from 763 the Tibetan Empire had taken the Hexi corridor and the Longyou prefectures step by step, and it now garrisoned depots above the Tao River and along the western frontier, dispatching mounted and foot columns eastward under commanders appointed by the tsanpo. Alongside the Tibetan troops the column included large numbers of Han and Tuyuhun people taken by levy or capture, and clergy enrolled as soldiers. Neither army fought the other's entire national force; this was a long tug of war over one river, a set of fords and the road that led to Guanzhong, with the Tang holding the walled towns and the Tibetans supplying the mobility.
people: 這場戰鬥留下的具體人名不多，但幾個位置可以確定。唐德宗在位第七年，正把精銳調去削藩，詔令節度使交出兵權，這一政策直接削弱了隴右守備。涇原方面在這幾年間更替主將：節度使劉忠亮病歿後，兵柄交到姚令言手中，這支部隊的忠誠問題從此埋下裂痕，兩年後即演成涇原兵變。河中節度使郭子儀在同一年病逝，諡忠武，他一手帶出的河中兵是唐廷在關中最可靠的支撐；他一死，朝廷再無第二人足以同時壓住諸鎮與安撫關中。劍南方向的西川節度使張蜇則在成都一線與吐蕃對峙，說明唐廷只能以分兵的方式同時應付兩條戰線。吐蕃方面由贊普調兵，統臨洺方向作戰的將領姓名在傳世記載中已難考實，能確定的只有：他率騎兵自洮水上游下來，走到臨洺城下。
peopleEn: Few individual names survive from this engagement, but several positions can be fixed. Emperor Dezong was in the seventh year of his reign, moving troops to strip the autonomous governors of their commands, and the same policy thinned the Longyou garrisons. In Jingyuan the commander changed hands in these years: the jiedushi Liu Zhongliang died in office and the troops passed to Yao Lingyan, whose loyalty to the court was already doubtful, and that crack opened the way for the Jingyuan mutiny two years later. Hezhong jiedushi Guo Ziyi died in the same year and was given the posthumous name Wuzhong; the forces he had raised at Hezhong were the sturdiest pillar the court possessed in Guanzhong, and with him gone no second man could hold the regional commands and the capital together at the same time. At the same time the Xichuan jiedushi Zhang Zhe was facing Tibet from Chengdu, which shows that the Tang could only answer two fronts at once by splitting its strength. On the Tibetan side the tsanpo dispatched the army, and the name of the officer who led the column down to Linming can no longer be recovered; what is certain is that he brought mounted troops down out of the upper Tao valley to the walls of the town.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬弩砲是公元前50年前後羅馬人改進的扭力投射器，一發一具，靠絞合的皮筋或繩索蓄能把單支大型弩箭射出；維特魯威在《建築十書》裡描述其幅廣約十二肘、高約三肘，扭力臂長約四、五肘，操作須數人分工，裝填一次、射擊一次。它是羅馬用來對付希臘式城牆的專門器械，也是羅馬拆掉希臘城邦防禦體系的技術象徵。但這件兵器在781年的臨洺城下不會出現，那裡的攻城與守城用的是另一套器械：唐軍的拋石機（文獻中稱砲、飛石）以配重甩擲石彈，射程遠而精度差，主要用來打擊城頭、樓堞與密集的攻隊；床弩與蹶張弩把弓力鎖進機括，精度與單箭威力都勝過手射弓，但射速慢、箭重而利，適宜居高臨下射擊城下的目標；守城一方另有檑木、撞車、穴地、火毯與拒馬槊互相搭配。吐蕃的攻具與羅馬弩砲在功能上其實更接近：同樣是投射單一大型彈丸的機械，差別在羅馬用扭力、唐代用配重，一者求射程與破壞力，一者求投射量。馬匹方面，吐蕃騎兵依賴青海與河曲一帶的馬匹，唐軍的戰馬除本地羖馬外，多來自互市與俘獲；糧秣靠屯田與關中沿渭水、隴山通道的車隊輸送，牛、駝擔負糧草與輜重。
kitsEn: The Roman ballista on the card is a torsion machine perfected around 50 BC: a single large bolt driven by twisted skeins of sinew or cord, and Vitruvius describes it in the De architectura as roughly twelve cubits wide and three cubits high, with a tension arm of four and a half cubits, worked by several men who loaded and aimed in turn, one shot for each loading. It was the Roman answer to Greek-style city walls and the technical emblem of the dismantling of the Greek city-state system. Nothing like it stood at Linming in 781. The siege and defence kit of that battlefield belonged to another family of machines: Tang catapults, called pao or feishi in the sources, threw stone weights by counterweight, with long range but poor accuracy, and were used against parapets, towers and dense assault columns; bed crossbows and pedal-drawn tension bows locked their power into a mechanism, giving greater accuracy and striking power than a hand bow but slow to reload, and suited to shooting down from a height at targets below the wall. Beside them the defenders used dropped beams, battering rams, sapping, fire blankets and caltrops in combination. In function the Tibetan siege engines stood closer to the Roman ballista: each also threw a single heavy missile, the difference being that the Romans stored energy in torsion while the Tang used counterweight, the one favouring range and impact, the other favouring volume of fire. Horses were the Tibetan column's true strength, drawn from the Qinghai and Huangshui valleys, while the Tang drew remounts from local herds, from the frontier markets and from captured animals. Grain came partly from garrison farms and partly from convoys running west along the Wei River and the passes of Longshan, with oxen and camels carrying grain and baggage.
tactics: 吐蕃的打法以騎兵機動為主。從洮水上游的據點出發，騎兵分成數股：一股逼近城下施壓，其餘各股在山地與河谷間迂迴，尋找唐軍援兵的方向，再轉成遮斷，盡量不讓關中或涇原的援軍與臨洺城會合。攻城時仍以步兵結陣接近，先用拋石機與弓箭壓制城頭，再以梯隊攀城，並用披甲的突擊隊填塞城下壕溝的缺口；城門一破，騎兵即湧入街道，把巷戰變成對唐軍守備的分割包圍。唐軍的回應是以城為依托的守禦：臨洺控住洮水南岸的渡口與東西通道，城周築壕置柵，守軍以弓弩居高臨下，出城游騎不斷襲擾敵軍側背與輸重隊伍，延緩其攻城準備；援軍抵達後再集中兵力反擊、收復失守堡寨，而不是主動遠征。節度使之間的調動受各鎮利益掣肘，一支援軍自涇州或河中出發，走隴山通道南下，多半要數十日；五月前後洮水正漲，泥濘拖慢騎兵與運糧車隊，這是雙方都受限的季節因素。
tacticsEn: Tibetan method rested on mounted mobility. Leaving their depots above the Tao River, the horsemen split into several columns: one pressed the city and kept the defenders pinned, while the others swung through the hills and gullies to locate the Tang reinforcement route and then turned to cut it, so that no force from Jingzhou or Hezhong could join Linming. For the assault the foot closed in in formation, first putting catapults and arrows onto the parapets, then bringing up ladders, with armoured shock troops filling the ditch below the wall; once a gate gave way, horsemen poured into the streets and turned street fighting into a piecemeal encirclement of the Tang garrisons. The Tang answer was a defence built on the town: Linming controlled the fords on the south bank of the Tao and the roads east and west, with ditch and palisade around the walls, bowmen posted high, and outlying light cavalry raiding the enemy's flanks and baggage trains to delay the preparations for a siege. Once reinforcements arrived, the Tang concentrated its strength to counterattack and retake the fallen forts rather than to campaign far afield. Movement between commands was checked by the interests of each regional governor, and a relief column coming from Jingzhou or Hezhong needed weeks to come down the Longshan road; in the fifth month the Tao was in flood, and the mud slowed both the cavalry and the grain wagons, a limit that bound both sides.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但都可靠。羅馬弩砲的年代是公元前50年上下，比這場戰爭早約八百三十年，維特魯威留下的尺寸是弩砲幅廣十二肘、高三肘、扭力臂長約四、五肘，換算約合五米多寬、兩米多高，操作要數人，裝填與瞄準各佔一人，此外還需人手搬運石彈與保養皮筋。唐軍的實際調動距離可從地理推算：臨洺到秦州治所今甘肅天水約一百三十公里，到蘭州約兩百公里，涇州到秦州也近兩百里，調兵在當時步騎的速度下要走上數日，加上沿途糧秣調撥，援軍抵達往往已過一旬。洮水自洮源流下，全長逾五百公里，最後匯入渭水，是兩軍反覆爭奪的天然分界。距離這場戰鬥十八年，763年吐蕃曾直逼京師、次年退去；再過兩年，涇原兵變起，叛軍入據長安，吐蕃趁勢取走秦州、洮州一線，唐的邊線再退數百里。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, but those that can are solid. The Roman ballista dates from about 50 BC, roughly eight hundred and thirty years before this war, and the dimensions Vitruvius preserves are twelve cubits wide and three cubits high, with a tension arm of four and a half cubits, something over five metres across and over two metres high, worked by several men, with one loading the frame and one on the sighting line, besides hands to carry the stone and to service the skeins. The Tang distances can be worked out from the geography: from Linming to the seat of Qinzhou, modern Tianshui, is about one hundred and thirty kilometres, and to Lanzhou about two hundred; Jingzhou lies close to two hundred li from Qinzhou, so a relief force on foot and horseback needed days to move once the grain was organised, and usually more than a fortnight before it closed with the defenders. The Tao rises at Taoyuan and runs more than five hundred kilometres before it joins the Wei, and it was the natural dividing line that the two armies pulled back and forth across. This fight came eighteen years after the Tibetans reached the neighbourhood of the capital in 763 and withdrew the following year, and two years before the Jingyuan mutiny of 783, when Zhu Ci took Chang'an and the Tibetans seized Qinzhou and Taozhou, pushing the Tang line back several hundred li.
cause: 臨洺之戰的起因是一連串的崩解。安史之亂抽空了隴右、河西的邊軍，755年後數年間吐蕃沿祁連山南北麓東進，763年攻到長安郊外，隨後把河西走廊的涼、甘二州與隴右的洮、岷、疊諸州一一收入，唐朝的西北屏障只剩秦州、渭州與臨洺這條狹長前線。戰後唐廷重建邊軍，卻再無力恢復府兵制，改以募兵為主，兵權、財權、治權逐漸歸於節度使一身；德宗又在此時推行削藩，把西部的精銳調去對付淄青、淮西等不奉詔的藩鎮，隴右的守兵在名額與士氣上都被抽走。吐蕃看見關中空虛，一方面加緊在洮水上游屯兵，另一方面把進攻目標定在臨洺這樣位置關鍵、駐軍不多、又無援軍在側的邊城，企圖先拔一城，震動整條防線。同一時期劍南方向也遭吐蕃進攻，唐廷分身乏術，只能以最小代價守住臨洺，把反攻的時間推遲到北方平定之後。
causeEn: The causes of the battle at Linming run back through a whole chain of collapses. The An Lushan rebellion emptied the Longyou and Hexi garrisons, and from 755 the Tibetans advanced along both flanks of the Qilian range, reaching the outskirts of the capital in 763 before taking the prefecture seats of Liang and Gan on the Hexi corridor and of Tao, Min and Die in Longyou, leaving the Tang only the narrow line of Qinzhou, Weizhou and Linming. The court tried to rebuild the frontier afterwards but could not restore the fubing system and turned to recruitment, so that command, money and civil administration drifted into the hands of the jiedushi; Dezong, pursuing the reduction of the autonomous governors, sent the best of the western troops east and south against the jiedushi of Ziqing and Huaixi, thinning the Longyou garrison in numbers and in spirit alike. Seeing an empty Guanzhong, the Tibetans reinforced their depots above the Tao and chose a target that was strategically placed, lightly held and unsupported: a border town like Linming, which if taken would shake the whole line. The same years saw Tibetan pressure on Jiannan, so the court, unable to be in two places at once, chose the smallest price for Linming and postponed the counterstroke until the north was quiet.
impact: 守住臨洺的直接後果，是唐廷在關中門戶前多爭取到兩年時間，而這兩年最終沒有被用來收復失地。783年涇原兵變，德宗出奔奉天，叛軍首領朱泚率涇原兵入據長安，僭號稱帝，關中亂了整整一年；吐蕃就在這時取走秦州與洮州，唐的隴右防線從前線退到渭水一帶，涇原與隴右的軍鎮也從邊防主力變成朝廷防禦京師、對付藩鎮的棋子。同一時期郭子儀病逝，唐廷失去最後一位能以個人威望統合河中諸軍的老將，削藩與邊防互相爭奪資源的結構性矛盾再也無法調和：為了平叛，邊軍被抽調；為了守邊，軍額被削減；為了削藩，軍隊被分散，結果是邊防與中央都變弱。從技術與制度層面看，這場戰鬥也留下兩個長期的樣本：其一，遠程投射器械與強弩在城防中的比重，決定了守方能在不取主動的情況下拖住優勢騎兵；其二，靠節度使節制邊軍的體制能守卻不能攻，防守的成功反而延後了體制改革的時機。
impactEn: The immediate effect of holding Linming was that the Tang court bought two more years before the gate of Guanzhong, and those two years were never used to recover the lost ground. In 783 the Jingyuan troops mutinied, Dezong fled to Fengtian, and the leader of the revolt, Zhu Ci, entered Chang'an at the head of the Jingyuan soldiers and proclaimed himself emperor, leaving the capital in disorder for a full year; the Tibetans took advantage of it and seized Qinzhou and Taozhou, so that the Tang frontier fell back to the Wei River and the commands of Jingyuan and Longyou, once the shield of the border, became the instruments the court used to guard the capital and to fight the regional governors. Guo Ziyi died in the same period, and the Tang lost the last old general whose personal authority could hold the Hezhong armies together; the structural contradiction between the reduction of the governors and the defence of the frontier could no longer be reconciled, since fighting the rebels required stripping the frontier, defending the frontier cut the numbers, and reducing the governors dispersed the forces, leaving both the border and the centre weaker. In terms of method and institutions the fight also left two long-term lessons: the weight of long-range artillery and heavy crossbows in a defence decides how long a walled town can hold off superior cavalry without ever taking the initiative; and a frontier administered through regional commands can defend but cannot attack, so the success of a defence postponed the moment when the system itself had to be reformed.
result: 就戰局本身而言，結果是唐軍守住臨洺城與洮水渡口，吐蕃退回洮水上游與河西方向的據點，出兵的目的沒有達成。現存唐人編年與《資治通鑑》對這場戰鬥的記載十分簡略，斬獲、損耗與雙方點兵都沒有留下可核對的數字，因此只能確定方向，不能確定尺度。就唐代整體邊防而言，這是一場典型的守勢成功：唐軍靠城池、地利與邊軍的陣地作戰換來一段安寧，卻沒有能力反攻；兩年後吐蕃利用涇原兵變與朱泚之亂攻入秦州、洮州，前線後退數百里，臨洺一度落入吐蕃手中，直到九世紀中期沙州歸義軍成立、張議潮收復河西，唐朝才重新把手伸回這條通道。從兵器史的角度看，這場戰鬥也說明八世紀的東亞攻城戰已不以希臘式城牆的攻城術為前提：羅馬弩砲那種一發一具、靠扭力蓄能的投射器，在唐人手上已換成配重式拋石機與機括弩，而真正決定臨洺歸屬的，是糧秣能不能送到、援兵能不能及時到位、節度使肯不肯把兵交出來。
resultEn: As to the course of the fight, the Tang held Linming and the fords of the Tao, and the Tibetans withdrew towards their depots above the river and in Hexi; the purpose of the Tibetan sortie was not achieved. The Tang chronicles and the Zizhi Tongjian keep this engagement very briefly, and no tally of killed, captured or lost that can be checked survives, so only the direction of the result is certain and not its scale. For the Tang frontier as a whole it was a typical defensive success: the town, the ground and the fixed garrisons of the border commands bought a period of calm, but there was no strength to counterattack; two years later the Tibetans used the Jingyuan mutiny and the revolt of Zhu Ci to take Qinzhou and Taozhou, the front receding several hundred li and Linming falling into Tibetan hands for a time, until the Guiyi Army was founded at Shazhou in the middle of the ninth century and Zhang Yichao recovered Hexi, and the Tang reached for that corridor again. Seen from the history of arms, the battle also shows that eighth-century siege warfare in East Asia no longer assumed Greek-style walls: the Roman ballista, one machine to one shot and driven by stored torsion, had in Tang hands become the counterweight catapult and the mechanism crossbow, and what really decided Linming was whether grain could be brought up, whether relief could arrive in time, and whether a jiedushi was willing to hand over his troops.
